summary: Identify the animal as an ox in the translation
rationale: The supplied context identifies the animal as u tawrayḏan (our ox) in 44/110, and 44/112 again calls it an ox in German. The masculine kale in 44/111 agrees with this. The added identification the cow is therefore factually wrong; change the animal name while retaining the bracketed clarification.
Erschickte is a misspelling. The first Turoyo form bʕīǧ belongs to bʕǧ, whose supplied glossary entry gives erwürgen, ersticken; erstickte supplies the intended verb.
